content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

This stack is built on base-layer internet protocols, not platforms. GitHub Pages hosts your storefront for free. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments on-chain. Google Drive delivers files instantly. No single point of failure. No platform can shut you down. You deploy once, own forever. The architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe against currency collapse and financial isolation. It works where Stripe and PayPal do not. Your customers pay in crypto. You receive USD equivalent. No volatility exposure. No buyer account required. This is infrastructure sovereignty, not a workaround.
What You Need Before You Deploy

You need three things: A crypto wallet to receive payments, a GitHub account for hosting, and your digital product files. Create a NOWPayments account—it’s free and requires no KYC. Choose a low-fee network like BSC, Solana, or TRON for transactions under $0.10. Prepare your ebook, course, or template files. Name them clearly. Structure your GitHub repository with a /public folder for the storefront and a /src folder for backend logic. If you’re using Google Apps Script instead of Cloudflare Workers, enable the Google Drive API. This setup takes less than an hour. You’ll deploy in 48 hours or less.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Connect NOWPayments to your crypto wallet. Generate API keys. Configure the webhook to trigger file delivery. In Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, write the delivery logic. When payment confirms on-chain, the script sends the download link via email. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to log orders. Test the pipeline with a $0.01 transaction. Ensure the file delivers instantly. Configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability if using Cloudflare. This pipeline is stateless. It scales to thousands of transactions without modification. You pay only the 0.5% fee per sale. No monthly costs. No platform taxes.
Gumroad takes 10%. NOWPayments takes 0.5%. At 100 sales of a $97 product, you retain $921 more per month.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Point your custom domain if you have one. Share the live URL. Your first customer selects a product, pays in crypto, and receives the file automatically. Monitor the Supabase or Google Sheets dashboard for orders. The system is self-sustaining. You do not touch it after deployment. No manual intervention required. The customer experience is seamless. They pay, they download. No accounts. No friction. You receive payment directly to your wallet. No waiting for payouts. No platform holding your funds.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Add more products by updating the /public folder and backend logic. Duplicate the pipeline for new offerings. Use Cloudflare R2 for larger file storage. Monitor transaction fees and switch networks if costs rise. The stack is modular. Upgrade components without downtime. Document your deployment for future reference. The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) includes scaling playbooks and full source code. You’re not building a store—you’re deploying infrastructure. It’s yours to expand. No platform limits. No revenue caps. You own the architecture. You control the growth.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Sell your ebook without PayPal or Stripe by deploying a sovereign stack. Host on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Use NOWPayments for crypto transactions. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This eliminates platform fees and restrictions. You keep 99.5% of revenue. The infrastructure is yours. No subscriptions. No intermediaries. Deploy once, own forever. This works in regions where conventional platforms are unavailable or restricted. It’s built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, and more.
This stack is not a workaround. It’s base-layer infrastructure. You own it. No platform can shut it down.

To deploy this stack in 48 hours, use the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) or Edge Commerce Stack ($197). For full documentation and source code, purchase The Sovereign Blueprint ($47) at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. These stacks are designed for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Pakistan, and other regions where Stripe and PayPal are restricted. They include automated delivery, crypto payment verification, and lifetime access. No platform fees. No revenue sharing. Own your infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Create a NOWPayments account and connect your crypto wallet. 2. Prepare your ebook or digital product files. 3. Set up a GitHub repository with /public and /src folders. 4. Write backend logic in Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure the payment webhook to trigger file delivery. 6. Test the pipeline with a small transaction. 7. Deploy your storefront to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 8. Share the live URL with your audience. 9. Monitor orders in Supabase or Google Sheets. 10. Add more products by duplicating the pipeline.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys the infrastructure for you in 48 hours. You provide your product files and crypto wallet address. COREMERCH handles the rest. You own the deployed stack. No technical skills required.
What cryptocurrencies can my customers use?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON. Transactions cost under $0.10. Your customers pay in their preferred currency. You receive USD equivalent.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually from your crypto wallet. The stack does not automate refunds. Document your refund policy clearly. Communicate directly with customers. No platform intermediaries.
Can I sell physical products with this stack?
No. This stack is designed for digital products like ebooks, courses, and templates. Automated delivery requires digital files. For physical products, you’ll need separate shipping infrastructure.
What happens if crypto prices fluctuate?
NOWPayments converts payments to USD at transaction time. You receive the USD equivalent. No volatility exposure. Your revenue is stable. Customers pay in crypto. You receive fiat value.
